fields.text: Sends a push notification for machine events, even when you're not looking at the browser tab. Pick a provider below - all three are free.

Free, no signup. Install the ntfy app (iOS/Android) or open ntfy.sh/<your-topic> in a browser, and subscribe to the same topic you set below. Pick something unguessable - anyone who knows the topic name can read it. Self-hosted ntfy servers work too, just change the Server URL.

Free. In a Discord server: Channel Settings -> Integrations -> Webhooks -> New Webhook -> Copy Webhook URL. Notifications show up as a message in that channel - handy if you (or your shop) already live in Discord.

Free. Message @BotFather on Telegram to create a bot and get a Bot Token. Then send your new bot any message, and open https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/getUpdates in a browser to find your numeric Chat ID.
Which events should send a notification:

fields.label: Job stopped due to an error
Connection to the controller lost unexpectedly
